au.source_name: Commonwealth of Australia Constitution Act, compilation as at 2013 (Federal Register of Legislation, transcribed on Wikisource)

ke.source_name: Constitution of Kenya, 2010 (official print, transcribed on Wikisource)
ke.license: Public domain (written law is excluded from copyright, Kenya Copyright Act 2001)

in.source_name: The Constitution of India (English version, Legislative Department, Ministry of Law and Justice)
in.license: Free to reproduce (Indian Copyright Act 1957, s. 52(1)(q): publishing an Act of a Legislature is not infringement)

za.source_name: Constitution of the Republic of South Africa, 1996 (Department of Justice and Constitutional Development)
za.license: Public domain (official legislative text, no copyright under s. 12(8)(a) of the Copyright Act 98 of 1978)

ng.reason: No consolidated official text. The Federal Ministry of Justice PDF (justice.gov.ng/wp-content/uploads/2020/09/Nigerian-Constitution.pdf, broken xref, pdftotext fails, pdf.js reads it) is the unamended 1999 text with the First to Third Alteration Acts (2010) appended as amending instructions, not merged; importing it would drop the alterations. Neither it nor Constitute has the Fourth (2018) or Fifth (2023) Alterations. Licence would be fine: Copyright Act 2022, s. 3(b) excludes official legislative texts. Keeps Constitute (CC BY-NC; the app is free and non-commercial).

gh.source_name: Constitution of the Republic of Ghana, 1992, as amended by the Constitution of the Republic of Ghana (Amendment) Act, 1996 (Act 527) (consolidated text published by the Office of the Special Prosecutor)
gh.license: Public domain (no economic or moral rights vest in anyone in an enactment, Ghana Copyright Act 2005 (Act 690), s. 8)

jm.reason: Not on Wikisource; laws.moj.gov.jm shows a maintenance page (503). The treasury.gov.jm PDF is an image scan of the 1962 Order with almost no text layer and predates the 2011 Charter of Fundamental Rights and Freedoms, so it would lose text. Keeps Constitute (CC BY-NC; the app is free and non-commercial).
